title: 1:1 prep - Marcus Li
body:
1:1 prep notes with Marcus (engineering manager)
Date: 2024-12-02 (weekly) - 30m
Location: Zoom
Attendees: Marcus Li (me), Priya Nair (report)

Purpose / framing:
- Quick sync on current priorities, unblockers, and growth conversations.
- Make decisions for next sprint scope and hiring ask.

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick wins & status (5m)
   - Priya: latency fixes for KV cache PR merged (see PR #432) - initial perf looks +12% at p95. Need to validate on canary.
   - Oncall handover went smoothly last week - thanks for handling the DB incident.

2) Blockers & risks (8m)
   - Autoscaler config oscillation still happening for small batches (JIRA ENG-912). Need to confirm whether kernel selection tuning in prod will help.
   - Infra: Dedicated cluster capacity for Q1 demo - ask for reservation by Fri? (discuss budget)
   - Priya: stuck on metrics noise for KV cache TTL; can we pair with Daniel?

3) Roadmap & priority alignment (8m)
   - Ship lightweight quantization profile RFC by EOD Thu (we committed this last sync). Status? (Priya)
   - Decide whether to push canary of 2.1 runtime to 20% or hold at 5% until perf tests clear. My instinct: hold at 5% until stable on p95 latency.
   - Hiring: approve IC3 backend hire for inference pipeline - need sign-off vs capacity trade-offs.

4) Career & growth (5m)
   - Discuss stretch project options: lead on quantization RFC + own rollout metrics.
   - Feedback loop: how is mentorship cadence working? Increase pairing to twice weekly?

5) Action items / wrap (4m)

Notes to self / prep TODO before meeting:
- Pull latest numbers from the canary dashboards (console -> serving-runtime -> canary/2.1) and paste top-level stats
- Re-read PR #432 and note any follow-ups to ask Priya about (validation plan + perf tests)
- Review JIRA ENG-912 comments and add a clear next step (file: "oscillation root-cause investigation")
- Draft hiring justification (brief bullets) to share during the meeting

Possible questions to ask Priya:
- Do you feel the perf regression is reproducible with the new kernel toggles? (need repro steps)
- How confident are you in the TTL changes? Do we need a small A/B with synthetic load?
- Would you be open to mentoring the new hire on batching and routing policies?

Decisions I'm hoping to land:
- Keep 2.1 canary at 5% until one full weekday of traffic shows stable p95 (< target).
- Approve hiring req for IC3 backend (headcount comes from infra backlog - present prioritization).
- If TTL noise persists after pairing with Daniel, schedule a short incident-style deep-dive next Tue.

Action items (explicit)
- Priya: finalize quantization RFC draft and attach perf checklist - due 2024-12-05. [owner: Priya Nair]
- Marcus (me): prepare canary dashboard snapshot + short note on risk tolerance before EOD today - due 2024-12-02.
- Marcus: circulate hiring justification doc to Eng Manager forum and Finance (cc: hiring@redwood) - due 2024-12-04.
- Daniel Ortiz: pair with Priya on TTL experiments (1.5h pairing session) - schedule by 2024-12-03.
- Priya: add replication steps for autoscaler oscillation to JIRA ENG-912 and tag SRE - due 2024-12-03.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this 1:1)
- Deep-dive on kernel selection logic for varying sequence lengths (request from product).
- Revisit cost tradeoffs for Dedicated burst capacity in Q1.
- Cross-team sync with console and rollout teams re: canary observability gaps.

Tone + meta notes:
- Keep action-focused, clarify "what success looks like" for each item.
- If hiring debate comes up, be ready with a short prioritization matrix (latency, reliability, delivery impact).
- Remember to ask Priya about workload balance and if she wants more leadership exposure.

Rough bullets for meeting start (script):
"Thanks - quick wins: DB oncall handover looked clean, and PR #432 reduces p95. For today's meeting I'd like to focus on blockers (autoscaler oscillation), get an alignment on the 2.1 canary %, and discuss the IC3 headcount request. Also want to check in on stretch project for you"

Unresolved questions / notes to log post-meeting:
- If we approve IC3 hire, what's earliest start? Budget cycle constraints? (ask Finance)
- Is there any external dependency blocking the TTL experiments (e.g., feature flag gating, data mesh)?

-- end of prep doc --
